description: One call: create a curated Christmas gift game (julklappsspel / secret santa) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

itemQueries.description: Each query is searched and added as a wish

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US, sv, de. Optional; amazon.com always returns English.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user, e.g. amazon.com (US, English, tag sw-julklappsspel-20) or amazon.se (Sweden, tag sw-julklappsspel-21). Optional: if omitted, en-US requests get amazon.com and everything else amazon.se. Never errors on a missing store.

name: create_and_fill
title: One-shot create and fill
